captions.dependence_rho0p0: Seed 100, dependence_rho0p0: all 10,000 generated rows, 20 predictors, 9,500 normal-origin and 500 positive-origin rows. Scatter shows the first two features only; a shift in one of the other 18 features need not be visible here. Histogram shows the largest absolute feature value in each row, normalized separately within each group; this is a construction summary, not a fitted detector score. Equal individual feature distributions do not imply equal distributions of this row maximum. Pearson heatmaps include all 20 features; boundaries mark four blocks of five. Reported within-block means exclude self-correlations and average 40 distinct feature pairs. Heatmaps share range [-1,1]; scatter limits, histogram bins and density scales are fixed within each family. Null labels identify independent groups with the same population distribution, without a deliberately introduced anomaly signal. Single-feature shifts also change positive-group correlations, whose target is 0.8/(1+delta^2/20). Sample correlations need not equal their population targets. Seed 100 was selected in the committed plan; no models were fitted to make these figures.
